items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was there another brother of Arnold in the past that played music? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Clarinet player, yeah.

ctx.x: You see, and sometimes he probably had a different man, you know, playing.
Was there another brother of Arnold in the past that played music? Somebody who was very good. Mm-hm.
Dave DePass you say was the clarinet player?
